title: 供应链劳工标准
summary: 评估公司供应链中的劳工标准管理，包括供应商审核、童工/强迫劳动防控与追溯。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Supply Chain Labor Standards Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Supply Chain Labor Standards is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the management and transparency of their supply chain and the working standards in the regions in which their suppliers are located.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍供应链劳工标准关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。供应链劳工标准属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖供应链管理与透明度，以及供应商所在地区的劳动标准。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: • Production delays due to labor unrest in supply chains.
blocks.content_cn: • 因供应链劳资冲突而导致生产延迟。

blocks.content: \- Reduced productivity and product quality.
blocks.content_cn: • 生产率和产品质量下降。

blocks.content: \- Loss of growth opportunities, market share or pricing power due to negative publicity and damage to brand value.
blocks.content_cn: • 因负面报道及品牌价值受损而丧失增长机会、市场份额或定价能力。

sections.title_en: Supply Chain Labor Standards Key Issue Score
sections.title_cn: 供应链劳工标准关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Supply Chain Labor Standards Key Issue Score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue Score is based on the Exposure Score and the Management Score using the formula below. The Exposure Score and the Management Score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue Score.
blocks.content_cn: 供应链劳工标准关键议题得分评估公司对该议题风险的敞口程度及管理情况。该关键议题得分根据下述公式，基于风险敞口得分和管理得分计算。两项得分的结合方式意味着：风险敞口越高，公司就需要展现越强的管理能力，才能取得相同的总体关键议题得分。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $KI_{i}$ is the Key Issue Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{i}$ is the Exposure Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $MGMT_{i}$ is the Management Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $MGMT_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的管理得分。

sections.title_en: Supply Chain Labor Standards Management Score
sections.title_cn: 供应链劳工标准管理得分

blocks.content: The Supply Chain Labor Standards Management score is based on the weighted average of the relevant indicator scores, modified by controversies. Default indicator weights may be adjusted for the relevance of business activities; an indicator has zero weight when the company has no exposure to the activity it covers.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分按适用指标得分加权平均，再按争议事件调整。指标采用默认权重，并可根据公司业务活动的相关性调整；公司对某指标覆盖的业务活动没有敞口时，该指标权重为零。

blocks.content: $$MGMT_i = \sum_j Indicator\_Score_{j,i} \times Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$$

MGMT_i denotes the Management score excluding controversies; j denotes an applicable indicator and i denotes the company. Component scores aggregate indicator scores using weights scaled within the component.
blocks.content_cn: MGMT_i为争议调整前的管理得分；j表示适用指标，i表示公司。组件得分按组件内重新归一化后的指标权重汇总，不应默认将各组件等权平均。

sections.title_en: • Supply chain code of conduct covers anti-discrimination.
sections.title_cn: • 供应链行为准则涵盖反歧视。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements forbidding suppliers from engaging in discrimination with regard to their employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司供应链行为准则是否要求供应商不得歧视员工。

sections.title_en: • Supply chain code of conduct covers child labor.
sections.title_cn: • 供应链行为准则涵盖童工。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's supply chain code of conduct forbids suppliers to use underage labor.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司供应链行为准则是否禁止供应商使用低于法定年龄的劳工。

sections.title_en: • Supply chain code of conduct covers forced labor.
sections.title_cn: • 供应链行为准则涵盖强迫劳动。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's supply chain code of conduct forbids suppliers to use forced labor.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司供应链行为准则是否禁止供应商使用强迫劳动。

sections.title_en: • Supply chain code of conduct covers freedom of association.
sections.title_cn: • 供应链行为准则涵盖结社自由。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements that suppliers respect freedom of association and allow workers to unionize if desired.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司供应链行为准则是否要求供应商尊重结社自由，并允许工人按意愿组织工会。

sections.title_en: • Supply chain code of conduct covers health and safety.
sections.title_cn: • 供应链行为准则涵盖健康与安全。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements regarding health and safety working conditions at supplier factories.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司供应链行为准则是否对供应商工厂的健康与安全工作条件提出要求。

sections.title_en: • Supply chain code of conduct covers minimum wage.
sections.title_cn: • 供应链行为准则涵盖最低工资。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements regarding the minimum wages that suppliers must pay their employees.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司供应链行为准则是否规定供应商必须向员工支付的最低工资。

sections.title_en: • Supply chain code of conduct covers paid overtime.
sections.title_cn: • 供应链行为准则涵盖加班报酬。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements that suppliers pay overtime wages when employees must work overtime hours.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司供应链行为准则是否要求供应商在员工必须加班时支付加班工资。

sections.title_en: • Supply chain code of conduct covers working hours.
sections.title_cn: • 供应链行为准则涵盖工作时长。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements limiting the amount of hours suppliers' employees may be required to work in a day or a week.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司供应链行为准则是否限制供应商要求员工每天或每周工作的时数。

sections.title_en: • Training of suppliers on labor-related social issues.
sections.title_cn: • 供应商劳工相关社会议题培训。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has specific training programs in place with its suppliers on its supplier code of conduct or specific labor-related issues.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否针对供应商行为准则或具体劳工问题，为供应商设置专门培训计划。

sections.title_en: • Supplier selection based on labor management performance.
sections.title_cn: • 根据劳工管理表现选择供应商。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company considers suppliers' performance in allocating or renewing contracts, and/or placing further orders.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司在分配或续签合同，以及追加订单时，是否考虑供应商的表现。

sections.title_en: - Scope of supplier audits.
sections.title_cn: • 供应商审计的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company conducts internal and/or external audits across its supply chain.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否在供应链中开展内部和／或外部审计。

sections.title_en: • Action taken to address supplier misconduct.
sections.title_cn: • 应对供应商不当行为的行动。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of developing a remediation action plan when incidents of noncompliance with its code of conduct are found.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否提供证据，证明发现违反行为准则的事件时会制定整改行动计划。

sections.title_en: - Extent of disclosure on instances of supplier misconduct.
sections.title_cn: • 供应商不当行为事件披露程度。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company discloses the frequency and type of noncompliance incidents found in its supply chain.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否披露供应链中发现的违规事件频率和类型。

sections.title_en: • Tier 1 supplier audits (direct suppliers).
sections.title_cn: • 一级供应商审计（直接供应商）。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether some or all Tier 1 suppliers (i.e., direct suppliers) are covered by the social audit program of the company.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司社会审计计划是否覆盖部分或全部一级供应商，即直接供应商。

sections.title_en: • Tier 2 suppliers audits (components).
sections.title_cn: • 二级供应商审计（零部件）。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether some or all Tier 2 suppliers (i.e., components) are covered by the social audit program of the company.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司社会审计计划是否覆盖部分或全部二级供应商，即零部件供应商。

sections.title_en: • Tier 3 suppliers audits (raw materials).
sections.title_cn: • 三级供应商审计（原材料）。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether some or all Tier 3 suppliers (i.e., raw materials) are covered by the social audit program of the company.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司社会审计计划是否覆盖部分或全部三级供应商，即原材料供应商。

blocks.content: Sources: company disclosures, International Labour Organization.
blocks.content_cn: 来源：公司披露；国际劳工组织。

sections.title_en: Supply Chain Labor Standards Exposure Score
sections.title_cn: 供应链劳工标准风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Supply Chain Labor Standards Exposure Score evaluates the company's exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Company-Specific Exposure Score only. The Company-Specific Exposure Score is scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of "ESG Ratings Methodology" for additional details. The following data sources and methodologies are used in the Exposure Score calculation:

sections.title_en: Company-Specific Exposure Score
sections.title_cn: 公司特定敞口得分

blocks.content: The Company-Specific Exposure Score is a simple average of the Brand Recognition Score and the Footprint Score:
blocks.content_cn: 公司特定风险敞口得分为品牌知名度得分与足迹得分的简单平均值：

blocks.content:
$$
C O M _ {S L S, i} = A v e r a g e \big (B R S _ {S L S, i} + F S _ {S L S, i} \big)
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $BRS_{SLS,i}$ is the Brand Recognition Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BRS_{SLS,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的品牌知名度得分。

blocks.content: \- $FS_{SLS,i}$ is the Footprint Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $FS_{SLS,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的足迹得分。

blocks.content: A Brand Recognition Score of 10 is assessed for companies that get featured on Interbrand's Top 100 Best Global Brands List. For companies not included on this list, the Brand Recognition Score is not assessed, and the Company-Specific Exposure Score is determined solely based on the Footprint Score.
blocks.content_cn: 入选英特品牌全球最佳品牌百强榜的公司，品牌知名度得分为 10。未入选的公司不评估品牌知名度得分，公司特定风险敞口得分仅依据足迹得分确定。

blocks.content: The Footprint Score is calculated using total estimated revenues from products manufactured in developing and frontier markets. $^{1}$
blocks.content_cn: 足迹得分根据在发展中市场和前沿市场制造的产品所产生的估算总收入计算。$^{1}$
